description: Defines the PythonRpcHandler singleton class which provides an interface for executing Python UDFs remotely, handling serialization/deserialization, exception handling, and type parsing within the torch::distributed::rpc namespace.

classes.name: PythonRpcHandler
classes.description: Singleton class providing interface to execute remote Python UDFs, handle serialization/deserialization, exception management, and type parsing in distributed RPC context.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of PythonRpcHandler.

methods.name: runPythonUdf
methods.description: Executes a pickled Python UDF and returns the result as a py::object.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a py::object into a string.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a string into a py::object.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Checks if the object is a RemoteException and throws it.

methods.name: handleExceptionGILHeld
methods.description: Handles exceptions when the GIL is already held.

methods.name: isRemoteException
methods.description: Checks if the object is an instance of RemoteException.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up py::objects to prevent segment faults at program exit.

methods.name: parseTypeFromStr
methods.description: Parses a string to recover the corresponding jit_type for RRef type recovery.

methods.name: getRRefProxyFunctions
methods.description: Returns Python functions for RRef proxy helpers.

methods.name: getRRefTypeFunctions
methods.description: Returns Python functions to retrieve the type of the object referenced by an RRef.
